description: Shodan InternetDB summary for an IPv4 address (free, no key): open TCP ports, host names seen, CPE software identifiers, tags and CVE IDs Shodan associates with the host. Data is from Shodan's last scan, so it can be days old; an IP with no data returns empty lists with known=false. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: security_shodan_host_summary
title: Security Shodan Host Summary
